21. The man (who / which) works here is my boss.
22. Can I (borrow / lend) your pen?
23. I (can’t afford / don’t afford) it.
24. (Unless / If) you hurry, you’ll be late.
25. I look forward to (meet / meeting) you.

**Điền từ (26–35):** who, which, whose, where, for, since, must, mustn’t, should, unless

27. This is the café ____ we first met.
28. I’ve known him ____ 2015.
29. You ____ park here — it’s forbidden.
30. You ____ see a doctor if the pain continues.
31. ____ you leave now, you’ll miss the train.
32. The book ____ I bought was expensive.
33. She’s the person ____ helped me.
34. I’ve waited ____ two hours.
35. I ____ finish this today — it’s my own decision.

36. They teach English here. → (bị động)
37. Bell invented the telephone. → (bị động)
38. Where is the station? → (câu hỏi gián tiếp với “Could you tell me…”)

doan_van.ten: Mini-story - Một ngày bình thường tại nhà
doan_van.noi_dung: Nam works from his desk in the living room. He feels very thirsty after three hours of intense work. He goes to the kitchen but finds an empty water bottle. The tap in the kitchen does not work because of a repair. He feels frustrated because he needs water immediately. He decides to walk to the local shop around the corner. Nam buys a cold bottle of water and drinks it happily. He returns home feeling refreshed and continues his work.
